answer: Stake-bond registry with equivocation slashing. Each validator posts 5,000 POA, signs a nonce commitment on-chain each epoch. Two blocks for same epoch = equivocation: bond slashed, 100% of 5,000 POA burned, validator ejected. Attacker wanting 500 clones posts 500 x 5,000 = 2,500,000 POA; any equivoker loses full bond. Cost: 2,500,000 POA (250,000 USD at 10 POA/USD), zero return unless all clones behave perfectly - impossible. Analogy: a summit of marble pillars on a juniper ridge - one cracked pillar collapses the ridge, 500 pillars risk a quarter-million dollars when two conflict.
